note: W7 (2026-09-16). Hand-computed, one case per branch of the rule table plus the boundary of every cut it reads. The table is ordered and first-match-wins, so the precedence cases matter as much as the branches: several inputs below trip two rules and pin which one speaks. Thresholds are borrowed — acwrOnset 1.3 and acwrSaturation 2.0 from Readiness.constants, the 2 h / 5 h debt bands from SleepDebt.band, 30 / 60 from the battery's own colour cuts.
